description: API gateway deploy introduces null pointer in auth middleware due to missing JWT secret config key

known_root_cause.description: Auth middleware refactor references config key 'auth.jwt_secret' that was not provisioned in the config service for prod. NullPointerException on every authenticated request.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Missing config key auth.jwt_secret causes NullPointerException in AuthMiddleware.validate() after deploy-abc123
